name: diffish
description: Explorable file-level dependency graph for JS/TS repositories

scripts.build: pnpm esbuild src/main.ts src/preload.ts src/scan.ts src/git.ts src/subgraph.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --outdir=dist && pnpm esbuild src/renderer.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer.js && cp src/index.html dist/
